In the Instrumental Determinative Compounds the words सर्व etc. are not सर्वनाम।

Terms: सर्वनाम

The word अनु , कर्म-प्रवचनीय when it has the force of the 3rd case.

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय-अनु

A word ending with the Instrumental -3rd case-affix is optionally compounded with what denotes quality, the quality being that which is instrumentally caused by the thing signified by what ends with the 3rd case-affix and with the word अर्थ 'wealth' and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष
An उपपद ending in third case-affix

etc. is compounded optionally with an indeclinable formed by the affix अम् and the compound is तत्-पुरुष।

Terms: समास-अव्यय

In the छन्दस् (Veda), the object of the verb हु 'to sacrifice' takes the affix of the 3rd case and of the 2nd case as well.

Terms: छन्दस्

The change to अम् of the Instrumental -3rd case and Locative -7th-case-affixes coming after an अव्ययीभाव compound that ends in अ , occurs diversely.

Terms: विभक्ति-elision

A word ending in the Instrumental -3rd case retains its accent before the Past Participle in क्त when it has a Passive meaning.

Terms: समास accent

A Neuter अङ्ग (stem) ending in a vowel except अ , of which there exists an equivalent, uniform masculine, is treated like the masculine, in the opinion of गावल before the vowel beginning affixes of the Instrumental -3rd case and the cases that follow it.

Terms: नुम् augment
